conversation.text:
Police: Did you call Xiyuan’s father?
Respondent: I’ve already called him several times, but he still hasn’t answered.
Respondent: We only see each other once a year on Xiyuan’s birthday. We basically don’t keep in touch otherwise.
Respondent: Honestly, it’s one thing not to answer calls usually, but how can he not answer my call at a time like this!
Respondent: Actually, on the day the police came to our home, I sent him a text message.
Respondent: It was the first time the child told me she missed her dad.
Respondent: Then I told him that Xiyuan missed him and asked if he could come see the child.
Respondent: But how could he be so cold-hearted...
